scenario.objective: Keep other applications audible when joining a Flutter voice channel on Android and macOS.
scenario.expected: Android keeps communication routing but does not request system audio focus for the voice session. macOS 14+ retains WebRTC voice processing and applies its minimum other-audio ducking level.
scenario.scope_limits: Physical audio behavior, older macOS versions, and platform-specific audio quality are not established by widget tests or builds.
